newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain wine producer CVNE plans public offering-paper.
newsitem.headline: Spain wine producer CVNE plans public offering-paper.

text.p: Spanish wine producer Compania Vinicola del Norte de Espana will make a public offering of 20 percent of its roughly 10 billion pesetas of capital, according to a report in the financial newspaper Expansion.
It was not possible to reach the company for immediate comment.

The group, which produces the brands CVNE, Imperial and Vina Real from the heart of Spain's Rioja wine region, was founded in 1879 by the grandfather of the current chairman, the newspaper said in its Saturday edition.
Top company officials currently hold 85 percent of its capital, the paper said.
